_meta.design: within-subject: each participant did 3 tasks with their usual method and 3 with Tathabbut; odd numbers used their usual method for tasks 1–3, even numbers for tasks 4–6
_meta.method: Message with six texts sent by the project owner; participants timed themselves with a phone stopwatch and replied in writing. Replies are recorded here verbatim as relayed by the owner, who keeps the original messages.
_meta.participants: 3 (numbered 5–7 because 1–4 took part in the 5 October trial); recruited by the team; no names collected
